q: Jaise packet ek router se doosre tak jaata hai, kya change hota hai?
explain: MAC address sirf ek hop ke liye hota hai, isliye har router par source/destination MAC badalta hai; IP end-to-end same rehta hai.

q: Router multiple matching routes mein se kaun sa choose karta hai?
explain: Router longest prefix match use karta hai, yaani sabse lamba (most specific) matching prefix chuno.

q: Kaun sa protocol link state hai aur Dijkstra algorithm use karta hai?
explain: OSPF link state protocol hai, poora network map banata hai aur Dijkstra se shortest path nikalta hai.

q: Dijkstra example mein links A-B=4, A-C=2, B-C=1 hain. Source A se B tak ka shortest cost kya hai?
explain: A -> C -> B ka cost 2 + 1 = 3 hai, jo direct A-B link (4) se sasta hai, to shortest cost 3.

q: traceroute routers ka pata kaise lagata hai?
options: Badhte TTL bhej kar aur ICMP Time Exceeded sun kar
explain: traceroute TTL 1, 2, 3... bhejta hai; har router jo packet drop karta hai wo ICMP Time Exceeded bhejta hai, jisse hop ka pata chalta hai.
